objective: Give the design kernel (§42) the person decision that lets a learned pattern take effect. Every pattern the kernel writes for itself starts PROPOSED — research absorption (server/services/design/absorb.ts ~176), recurrences (server/services/design/learn.ts ~261) and owner corrections (server/services/design/patterns.ts ~401) — and `patternsInScope` (patterns.ts ~285) reads only ACTIVE patterns. The only function that moves a pattern PROPOSED→ACTIVE is `activatePattern` (server/repos/design.ts ~1252), and it has no caller anywhere in the repository; `retirePattern` (~1260) and `retireSurface` (~215) have none either. So the kernel's learning and expansion loops write patterns nothing can ever apply, and the comment at patterns.ts ~354 names activation as 'a separate decision' that nothing implements. Add that decision as a service function in server/services/design/patterns.ts and reach it from the existing terminal surface scripts/design.ts, attributed exactly the way its `correction` command already resolves `--admin` (scripts/design.ts ~476-497: getUserByEmail, refuse an unknown address).
expectedOutcome: server/services/design/patterns.ts exports `decidePattern({ patternId, action: 'ACTIVATE' | 'RETIRE', reason, actorUserId })` returning `{ ok: true, changed: boolean } | { ok: false, reason: string }`. ACTIVATE refuses a pattern whose scope is ONE_OFF (a one-off correction can never become a pattern, §42), refuses a RETIRED pattern, and is idempotent through the repository's guarded update (a second activation returns changed=false). RETIRE requires a non-empty reason and stores it as retired_reason. A matching `decideSurfaceRetirement({ surfaceKey, reason, actorUserId })` wraps `retireSurface`. scripts/design.ts gains `patterns [--state PROPOSED|ACTIVE|RETIRED]` (read-only listing: id, state, scope, primitive, branch, statement), `pattern activate <id> --admin <email>`, `pattern retire <id> --reason "…" --admin <email>` and `surface retire <key> --reason "…" --admin <email>`, each refusing an --admin address that resolves to no account and printing the outcome in one line.
nonGoals: Any HTTP route or client UI (server/routes/design.ts and server/services/design/view.ts are owned by another campaign).
Automatic activation of any pattern, or any change to how patterns are proposed, absorbed or scoped.
A migration or a change to server/repos/design.ts beyond what the service needs to call (prefer no change there).
Changing measured-lane evaluation or the repair loop.

acceptanceConditions.statement: A PROPOSED pattern created through the existing correction path is absent from patternsInScope; after decidePattern ACTIVATE it is present; a second ACTIVATE returns ok with changed=false.
ACTIVATE on a ONE_OFF-scoped or RETIRED pattern is refused with a reason and changes no row.
RETIRE with an empty reason is refused; with a reason it sets state RETIRED and retired_reason, and the pattern leaves patternsInScope.
decideSurfaceRetirement removes the surface from listSurfaces() while listSurfaces({ includeRetired: true }) still returns it with its reason.
scripts/design.ts contains the four new commands and each mutating one refuses an --admin address with no account (asserted by a test that reads or runs the script).

rollbackRequirement: Discard the branch. One service function pair and four terminal commands over existing guarded repository updates; no schema, route or policy change.
